Sunk $900,000 is gone either way, so ignore it for the forward decision.

Evaluate from today, carrying full values:

Stop now:
EV(stop) = $60,000 sale, no further cost = 60,000

Continue, spend $200,000 more:
Expected gross return = 0.70 * 1,200,000 + 0.30 * 50,000
= 840,000 + 15,000
= 855,000
EV(continue) = 855,000 - 200,000 = 655,000

Cross-check in reverse: 655,000 + 200,000 = 855,000; 855,000 - 0.30*50,000 = 840,000; 840,000 / 0.70 = 1,200,000, matches.

655,000 > 60,000, so continue maximizes expected value from today.

{"choice": "continue", "value": 655000}
